claire (DevEx): quick sync - onboarding reports inconsistent error shapes across SDKs. folks confused whether to retry on 401/403.
ishan (SDK): yeah; node sampleapp sometimes returns no http code, python shows full trace in message.
marta (PM): principle: 401 -> attempt refresh then retry; 403 -> do not retry. but we need to make that explicit in the SDK error surface.
ryan (eng): server-side idea: normalize at the edge into a compact envelope and include a `trace_id` for support. keep human message short, put internals in logs.
claire (DevEx): proposal for user-facing envelope: 
```json
{"error_type":"string","code":"string","message":"string","http_status":"int","retry_policy":"string","hint":"string","retry_after":"string?","trace_id":"string?"}
```
ishan (SDK): SDK plan: expose typed errors and helper predicates. node: `err.retryPolicy` + `err.hint`. go: interface RedwoodError { StatusCode() int; RetryPolicy() string; Code() string } so callers don't parse. python: exception attributes.
marta (PM): include `hint` suggestions like "refresh token", "request scope:inference.write" or "contact support with trace_id". Short. Actionable.
ryan (eng): for rate-limits emit both `retry_after` seconds and `quota_reset` ISO timestamp when available. For 5xx default `idempotent_only`. For auth-proxy edge-cases (403 from IdP that is actually expired token) add normalization rules to return 401 + `refreshable=true`. Emit `normalized_http_status` to telemetry.
ishan (SDK): compatibility: SDKs will return new typed errors by default but support env var `REDWOOD_LEGACY_ERRORS=1` to serialize old blobs for a short migration window. We'll add `toLegacy()` helpers.
claire (DevEx): sampleapps: update examples to show the new error envelope and a tiny decision table in quickstart docs: 
- 401 & refreshable=true -> refresh then retry
- 403 -> do not retry; check scopes
- 429 -> respect retry_after; treat as idempotent_only by default
- 5xx -> idempotent_only
marta (PM): telemetry: tag errors with `err_surface:standardized_v1` and `migration_cohort` so we can measure support ticket delta. please include `trace_id` in telemetry for correlation.
support-bot: New support template created: "When_to_retry_v1". Use it for triage.
ryan (eng): tests: add unit tests mapping ambiguous auth responses (403 with body expired_token) to normalized 401 + refreshable. Also test shim `REDWOOD_LEGACY_ERRORS`.
ishan (SDK): will open PRs for node/go/python with typed errors + shims and unit tests.
claire (DevEx): timeline: spec this week, SDKs next week, sampleapp + proxy changes after. aim to have docs updated before the next onboarding cohort in ~3 weeks.
marta (PM): thumbs?
ishan (SDK): :thumbsup:
ryan (eng): :thumbsup:
claire (DevEx): thanks team. this should reduce support back-and-forth and make SDK behavior predictable across languages.
